entities.summary: Independence & Polish-Soviet War, a transformative movement in Poland (1918–1926). Emerged from Treaty of Riga and Polish independence restored. Catalyzed Battle of Warsaw — 'Miracle on the Vistula' and German invasion of Poland — WWII begins.
